The '''3300 Hawkeye sharpshooter's barrel''' was a model of [[marksman barrel]] produced by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] and available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EOTEC" /> At two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, the barrel was compatible with only [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and cost 1200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], increasing a rifle's range and accuracy.<ref name="AORC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 330 Hawkeye sharpshooter's barrel was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].
